case_generation.domains: derive every domain_quality entry from the profile contract
case_generation.advertised_capabilities: expand every authoritative capability rule; do not maintain a second pair or mode list
case_generation.fixed_workloads: derive every tier and exact count from the profile contract
case_generation.runtime_adapters: derive every runtime compiled variant and its f8_execution_test from the kernel/device inventory

public_api.rule: Fixtures create, mutate, step, synchronize and read state only through the installed public API. Driver-private state cannot satisfy an assertion.
public_api.unsupported_rule: A driver that does not enumerate the exact profile produces an unsupported result, never a pass or a legacy fallback.

fixture.motion: two bounded crossing pairs and one separated negative-control pair

required_observations: public stable IDs before and after the step
one spatial publication and no private pair sort

fixture.interface: two four-by-two particle slabs sharing a planar boundary

required_observations: finite reconstructed interface response through public particle state
zero missing swept candidates at the interface
nonzero public paint field after contact
retired generation is absent after replacement
replacement generation can receive a later stamp

spatial_candidate_oracle.shape: continuously swept spheres with per-leaf support radius and maximum solver correction
spatial_candidate_oracle.requirement: every continuous swept overlap must appear; false positives are permitted

work_accounting.dispatch_rule: the total equals the sum of emitted phase dispatches; F8-21 sets candidate/device ceilings
work_accounting.iteration_rule: active algebraic budgets equal the profile exactly; coupling sweeps equal registered edges times four
work_accounting.index_rule: at most one update and exactly one publication per successful tick
work_accounting.readback_rule: intra-tick host readbacks are zero; explicit post-completion public queries are separate
work_accounting.failure_rule: failed ticks publish and advance zero times, preserve state/clock/inputs and emit no hidden retry substeps or index updates

timing.warmup: exclude exactly the contract warmup prefix
timing.samples: retain every measured tick including stalls
timing.gpu_unavailable: label unavailable and leave GPU phase samples absent; never substitute host time

legacy_separation.baseline_policy: A one-substep legacy baseline is recorded under its own profile and may fail realtime assertions. The failure is retained; neither threshold nor profile identity changes.
legacy_separation.current_runtime_state: Reference drivers enumerate no realtime profile until solver implementation tasks complete. Unsupported is explicit and is not qualification evidence.
